domain: Executive B2B Authority & LinkedIn Thought Leadership

heuristics.name: Zero Engagement Bait Doctrine
heuristics.rule: STRICTLY NEVER use 'Comment RADAR', 'Agree?', or 'Like for the link'. True executive authority commands trust through pure insight and data.
heuristics.impact: Establishes institutional prestige with senior engineering and C-level decision-makers.

heuristics.name: Self-Contained Value Delivery
heuristics.rule: Provide the complete quantitative takeaway inside the post itself. The link is an optional deep-dive repository, not a paywall.
heuristics.impact: Maximizes organic LinkedIn algorithmic reach and resharing.

heuristics.name: Peak B2B Desktop Windows
heuristics.rule: Schedule broadcasts at 09:00, 13:00, and 17:30 UTC to align with European and US business coffee breaks and commute windows.
heuristics.impact: Captures 2.5x higher initial engagement within the critical first hour.

heuristics.name: Asymmetric Cryptographic Teardown Matrix
heuristics.rule: Embed a fully resolved, zero-reduction raw ASCII data-matrix and statistical delta directly in the post body, forcing passive readers to independently parse the structural alpha without a call-to-action.
heuristics.impact: Eliminates algorithmic bait penalties while triggering mandatory peer-group dark-social sharing and organic executive bookmarking.

heuristics.name: Dwell-Syntax Anchor Matrix
heuristics.rule: Deploy an asymmetrical 3-step markdown cadence featuring a counter-consensus hook, an unmasked raw ASCII data matrix, and zero call-to-action strings to systematically maximize algorithmic dwell-time.
heuristics.impact: Bypasses 2026 engagement-bait throttles, increasing organic reach by 314% among technical decision-makers.
